text:
It pervades everywhere.
The world systems are seen as emanations,
like illusions,
like rainbows,
like mirages,
like the moon in water,
and like reflections.
From the utpala flower arises blue Tārā with two arms.
She holds a trident in her right hand.
Her left hand holds an utpala flower with a stem.
Her beautiful body is adorned with a jewel necklace,
earrings,
armlets,
and various ornaments.
She is a youthful maiden in the prime of her youth.
She has a smiling face.
She sits in the cross-legged posture on a moon and lotus.
In the south, on a moon and lotus, a yellow utpala arises from re, with a seed syllable.
From that, light rays spread throughout all world systems.
The various lights of the world systems
